name: Karnataka sustainable data center park - Mysuru
notes: Karnataka officials described a 1 GW three-city sustainable data-center-park program across Bengaluru, Mysuru and Mangaluru; Bengaluru is planned for 500 MW, with remaining capacity to be split between Mysuru and Mangaluru. Suitable land in Mysuru was still to be identified, so capacity for Mysuru is not yet public.

name: Datasamudra Mysuru edge data centre
notes: ETtech reported Datasamudra plans smaller 5 MW edge centres in Mysuru and Hubballi-Dharwad as part of a Karnataka expansion outside Bengaluru.

Searched public web for Raichur/Raichuru datacenter, data centre, hyperscale, colocation, and named cloud/operator terms; results showed general district and infrastructure items but no named data center project or operating facility.

name: NxtGen Bidadi Data Centre Campus
developer: NxtGen Datacenter and Cloud Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
notes: Public reporting identifies NxtGen Data Centre and Cloud Technologies at Bidadi Industrial Area, Ramanagara as the major data-center project that has materialised under Karnataka's policy, on about 10 acres with about Rs 2,000 crore investment. New Project Tracker records a Rs 20,000 million Bidadi data-centre approval updated 2021, but promoter details are paywalled; treated here as supporting evidence, not a separate project.
